name: away_natvent_activates_free_cooling__whf
description: [whole-house-fan twin of golden 'away_natvent_activates_free_cooling'; Issue #1193] Away mode, warm day: a window opens while away with outdoor (68F) cooler than indoor (74F). Natural ventilation activates — free cooling is free cooling, home or away. The user opts into fan-assisted ventilation by configuring a fan; occupancy does not gate it. #231 ensures nat-vent exits at the comfort ceiling so an empty home is not over-cooled below comfort.
source: Issue #1193: whole-house-fan twin of golden 'away_natvent_activates_free_cooling' (pre-#1140 version, fan configured). The golden is locked and now asserts the no-fan 'paused' result.
notes: Occupant outcome: the home pre-cools for free off the open window + configured fan while away, cutting the AC load on return. The user chose this by configuring a fan; not configuring a fan is how a user opts out of nat-vent.
Design note: nat-vent activation is gated on fan configuration + temperature, NOT occupancy. (An earlier change, #254, wrongly added an occupancy block; reverted — fan config is the opt-in.)
Regression proof: if an occupancy guard is (re-)added to nat-vent activation, the 14:00 assertion flips from 'natural_ventilation' to 'paused' and this scenario fails.
whole_house_fan twin (Issue #1193): with a whole-house fan configured, an open window with usable outdoor air runs the fan and suppresses HVAC (rule 2: fan and HVAC never together).

events.note: Morning classification — warm day (high 80 / low 60 -> classify_day: warm, hvac_mode off, windows recommended 06:00-10:00), comfort band armed (occupied)
Afternoon: indoor 74F, outdoor 68F — nat-vent eligible by temperature (outdoor < indoor, indoor > comfort_heat)
Window opens while away with cool outdoor air — nat-vent activates (free cooling); occupancy does not block it

assertions.reason: [whole-house-fan twin] sensor_open while away with outdoor (68F) < indoor (74F) and a fan configured — natural ventilation activates for free cooling. Occupancy does not gate nat-vent; the user opts in/out via fan configuration. #231 handles the comfort-ceiling exit so the empty home is not over-cooled.
Rule 2/3 guarantee: once the whole-house fan session starts, no climate command may select cool or heat for the rest of the run; HVAC stays off while the fan ventilates the house.

verdict.summary: [whole-house-fan twin] Nat-vent activates while away for free cooling — fan configuration is the opt-in, not occupancy; #231 exits at the comfort ceiling
verdict.observed_behavior: classification_applied -> away setback (79F) -> natural_ventilation on sensor_open at 14:00 (free cooling)
verdict.expected_behavior: An open window with cool outdoor air activates fan-assisted ventilation regardless of occupancy; users opt out by not configuring a fan
